findings.evidence: The proof uses only `splitLastEquiv (p + 1)` on the positive block (line 736) and `realCliffordWeight_of_lt`/`_of_le`; `splitLastEquiv n` is defined for all `n` (line 428). The sibling `realBottSplitIsometry` (line 512) is stated at the minimal indices `(p + 1, q + 1)`, so this is also inconsistent with the file's own convention.
findings.fix: State it as `(realCliffordForm (p + 1) q).IsometryEquiv ((realCliffordForm p q).prod (QuadraticMap.sq))`, re-index `signatureSwitchSplitIndexEquiv`/`signatureSwitchSplitWeight_*`/the three `@[simp]` coordinate lemmas the same way, and instantiate at `p + 1` in `realCliffordSignatureSwitchRecurrenceEquiv` (whose statement is unchanged).
findings.issue: `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry` is exported only at `realCliffordForm (p + 1 + 1) q ≃ (realCliffordForm (p + 1) q).prod sq`, i.e. it refuses to split the last positive coordinate off `Cliff(1, q)`. Nothing in the construction needs a positive coordinate to remain; the `+1` is an artifact of the one caller wanting `p + 2`.

findings.evidence: `signatureSwitchStandardIndexEquiv` (line 877) splits only the `q` block via `splitLastEquiv q`; `Fin (p + 1)` appears solely as a `sumComm`/`sumAssoc` block. The weight proofs use `i.isLt` and `finSumFinEquiv` bounds (lines 920-931), all uniform in `p`.
findings.fix: State it as `((-(realCliffordForm p q)).prod (QuadraticMap.sq)).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm (q + 1) p)` (with `signatureSwitchStandardIndexEquiv : Fin ((q + 1) + p) ≃ Fin (p + q) ⊕ Fin 1` and the three `@[simp]` lemmas re-indexed), and apply it at `p + 1` in the recurrence.
findings.issue: Same defect in `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry`: it is stated only for `(-(realCliffordForm (p + 1) q)).prod sq ≃ realCliffordForm (q + 1) (p + 1)`. The `p + 1` block is never split or inspected, so the restriction excludes the `p = 0` case (`-(realCliffordForm 0 q) ⊕ ⟨1⟩ ≃ realCliffordForm (q+1) 0`) for no reason.

findings.evidence: Both routes give the same map: the fused equiv sends the `q`-block to `castAdd (p+1) (castSucc i)`, `r` to `castAdd (p+1) (last q)` and the `p+1`-block to `natAdd (q+1) i` (lines 990-1034), which is exactly block-swap followed by `(realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry q p).symm`. No negation isometry for `realCliffordForm` exists in the repo: `grep -rn "IsometryEquiv" TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/*.lean` returns only lines 513, 813, 963 and the two `RealForm.lean` transports.
findings.fix: Add `realCliffordFormNegIsometry (p q) : (-(realCliffordForm p q)).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm q p)` (pure block swap, no `splitLast`), and define the fused isometry as `(prodCongr that (refl sq)).trans (realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry q p).symm` with the generalized split of finding 1.
findings.issue: `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry` fuses two independent facts — that negating a signature form swaps its signature, and that adjoining `sq` adds a positive coordinate — so the general statement `(-(realCliffordForm p q)).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm q p)` is never available, and ~70 lines of index/weight bookkeeping re-prove the same last-coordinate split as `signatureSwitchSplitIndexEquiv`.

summary: The generic sign switch sits at the right level, but both new public isometries are gratuitously indexed at `p + 1` positive coordinates when their proofs are uniform in `p`, and the sign-switch-to-standard isometry bakes in an unstated general fact (negating a signature form swaps `p` and `q`) instead of deriving from it.
